text:
Ruth Kim: Heads-up from Biomedica procurement: their Nov renewal invoice shows an unexpected line: "Platform Fee (experimental-rate) $4,500" in addition to the usual private license platform fee. They asked why. @OmarHaddad @ClaraJensen

Omar Haddad: Hmm. I see INV-2026-0499 in portal. Looks like during the Q3 pricing experiment we issued short-term experimental credits and new SKU codes. Possibly the pipeline included the experimental SKU plus the standard SKU for migrated customers.

Clara Jensen: Biomedica did a private deployment migration on 2026-09-12 and opted into the trial pricing for October only per AMND-912. That trial should have expired 2026-10-31. Why would it show on Nov invoice?

Support Billing Bot: Invoice INV-2026-0499 generated by billing-pipeline v3.3.0. Auto-check: unexpected SKU on invoice for account BIOM-0032.

Ruth Kim: Procurement needs a corrected invoice for their AP team. Can we confirm the net impact quickly?

Omar Haddad: Pulling invoice lines: 
```
Invoice INV-2026-0499
Customer: Biomedica Labs
Period: 2026-11-01 - 2026-11-30
Line items:
 - Platform Fee (Private License): $16,000
 - Platform Fee (experimental-rate): $4,500
 - Reserved Capacity: $32,000
 - Support (Enterprise Plus): $18,000
 - Migration service credit: -$2,000
Total: $68,500
```

Omar Haddad: Experimental-rate $4,500 should not be present. It should have dropped off 10/31. Net credit to issue = $4,500. Migration credit is valid and stays.

Clara Jensen: Also check support tier timing. Sales notes show Enterprise Plus effective 2026-11-05 (AMND-912). For Nov invoice we should prorate Enterprise Plus from 11/0530 and Standard from 11/011/04. Pipeline appears to have applied full Enterprise Plus for the month. That overbill amount is $4,200 (Enterprise Plus $18,000 vs Standard $15,000 full month; prorate makes difference). We need to combine both corrections.

Ruth Kim: So two issues: experimental SKU should be removed ($4,500) and support should be prorated reducing invoice by $4,200. Net credit = $8,700.

Support Billing Bot: Creating ticket BILL-9958: "experimental SKU + support prorate misapplied on renewal for BIOM-0032".

Sales Manager: Customer flagged this as high-priority for AP; they need a corrected invoice + short, neutral explanation for audit. Also asked for any notes showing the change history for AMND-912.

Omar Haddad: I'll open engineering ticket and add unit tests around pricing-experiment SKUs lifecycle. BILL-9958 created and assigned to eng-billing.

Clara Jensen: Legal prefers neutral language. Draft reply to procurement: "We identified an inconsistency on invoice INV-2026-0499 and have issued a credit memo to correct it. A revised invoice will be provided within 48 business hours. Please let us know if you need any additional documentation for audit." Add sales contact for follow-up.

Ruth Kim: Approved. Finance Ops, can you prepare credit memo and reissue invoice?

Finance Ops: Preparing CM. Need final confirmed credit amount. Please confirm net $8,700 credit. Also confirm reissued invoice ID pattern.

Omar Haddad: Confirmed net credit $8,700. Reissued invoice will be INV-2026-0499R. Also will attach amendment AMND-912 excerpt showing effective dates.

Finance Ops: Created CM-2026-067 for $8,700 and reissued INV-2026-0499R with corrected totals. Uploaded to portal and emailed procurement with neutral wording and AMND excerpt.

Support Billing Bot: BILL-9958 status: in progress. Patch PR opened to remove expired experiment SKUs at invoice generation and to improve support-tier prorate logic.

Sales Manager: Procurement acknowledged receipt and said they'll use corrected invoice for PO release. Thanks team.

Ruth Kim: Finance Ops please post journal entries and mark resolved. Also Omar, add a follow-up to ensure pricing experiments are gated and flagged so they never reappear on later invoices.

Finance Ops: Journal entries posted. CM-2026-067 applied. Marking thread resolved.

Support Billing Bot: INV-2026-0499 status: corrected (INV-2026-0499R). CM-2026-067 applied. BILL-9958 open until deploy.
